source: SYNTHETIC intermediate thumb fixture; not PICO sensor observations
coordinate_system: Unity left-handed tracking-origin local; x right, y up, z forward; meters; quaternion x,y,z,w
sdk_conversion: PICO native path: Vector3f.ToVector3=(x,y,-z), Quatf.ToQuat=(x,y,-z,-w), applied once. Synthetic/replay positions already use Unity coordinates.
sampling: Provider batch timestamps; inspect source. PICO live queries once per Update and may repeat sensor samples; Update rate is not sensor frequency. HandJointLocations has no SDK timestamp. Synthetic/replay batches are not sensor acquisitions.
validity: Provider validity plus numeric/geometry guards. PICO uses isActive and PositionValid/OrientationValid; synthetic fixtures use programmed flags. Original SDK flags are retained when available. Flags are not calibrated confidence.
